raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 9  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly interpreted or failed to resolve ambiguity surrounding Andrew Bowler's educational background. Despite indications that conflicting sources referenced both the Tisch School of the Arts at NYU and USC School of Cinematic Arts, WebSurfer repeatedly presented data asserting NYU Tisch without adequately verifying it using authoritative sources or addressing the inconsistencies. The reliance on auto-generated snippets and failing to prioritize official university sources (e.g., NYU.edu or USC.edu) contributed to the propagation of incomplete or potentially incorrect information.
